title: Workflow Technical Reference
readerIntent: Audit durable process definitions and execution evidence.
owner: Application workflow family and generic nbpm integration
summary: Every process defines version, graph, actions, channels, actors, durable state, context, side effects, recovery, retention, and tests.

sections.heading: Checklist
items: Definition/version, carrier/items, head, allowed graph, actions, channels, splits, aggregation, and terminals.
Manual/automatic type, authorization, service identity, tenant context, input/output, timeout, retry, idempotency, and cost.
Events, target modules, external APIs/AI, compensation, reconciliation, cancellation, late events, retention, and audit.
Positive, negative, boundary, permission, tenant, transition, decision, event, concurrency, restart, performance, integration, and regression tests.
